item.title: Federal Court of Appeal Upholds Ottawa’s Listing Plastics “Toxic”
item.description: TORONTO – The Canadian Constitution Foundation (CCF) is disappointed that the Federal Court of Appeal has overturned a Federal Court decision that had found the Trudeau government’s decision to label “plastic manufactured items” as toxic was unreasonable. The CCF intervened in the case to help the Court understand the limits of the federal government’s power to use criminal law to regulate plastics.
